profile.headline: Audio Software Engineering
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary: I am always seeking interesting challenges.  I am a problem solver, so technology has been a perfect fit.  My skill set is varied, but my passion and enthusiasm for challenges is unwavering. There is nothing better than digging into a technical issue and finding an elegant solution.

positions.title: Embedded Audio/DSP Software Engineer
positions.description: Complete development of embedded Linux devices: build environment, custom drivers, applications, hardware development, networking, digital rights management, web interface, project management, automated unit testing, revision control, documentation.  Development environments include C, C++, Perl, PHP, Java, assembly, shell scripting.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for industry leading DVD players, audio compression methodologies, Bluetooth, PWM engines, and micro projectors.  Responsibilities included software architecture, code development, and project management.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for a highly successful audio synthesizer processor, including Windows drivers, user interface, custom applications, and low-level hardware interfaces. The processor was a market leader in Asian musical instruments and on laptop computers.

Designed and oversaw the manufacturing of audio speaker systems for musical instruments.

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description: Develop scientific instrumentation for the measurement of crustal deformation.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description: Basic IT services.  Developed an award winning networking scheme.

patents.title: Audio signal generator to emulate three-dimensional audio signals.
patents.description: A method to trick your ear into thinking a helicopter is flying around you.  Among other things.
